description:
Build multi-hop protein interaction network from seed targets.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table interaction — one record = one interactor pair mapped to one gene pair, aggregated over the pair's evidence in one source database.
Key: sourceDatabase, intA, intB, targetA, targetB (targetB may be null).
Arguments: seed_targets accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.edge` counts edges; `_vbt.grains.partner` counts partners.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Interactions from IntAct, Reactome, SIGNOR and STRING mapped to genes by OT 25.09; absence means no record in these sources.
The frontier is expanded in key order and edges are keyed by source database and interactor pair, so the same call gives the same network; network_truncated and statistics.network.frontier say where max_network_size cut it.
Scores of different sources are not comparable; min_confidence other than 0 is refused.

seed_targets.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

sourceDatabase.description: Results are listed per sourceDatabase; pass one value to restrict them.
